<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_VacationRequest"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DecideRequest" name="Approve or reject request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decide_Outcome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestOutcome" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decide_Outcome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" name="Return rejected request to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_ReviewReasons</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewReasons" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_ReviewReasons</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_RejectedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_RejectedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyHR" name="Generate notification to Human Resources Representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_Procedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteProcedures" name="Complete management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_Procedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procedures_ApprovedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresComplete" name="Management procedures complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procedures_ApprovedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Register" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_DecideRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_DecideRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome" targetRef="Task_NotifyHR">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_ReviewReasons" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_RejectedEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Procedures" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHR" targetRef="Task_CompleteProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_ApprovedEnd" sourceRef="Task_CompleteProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
